statement: Documentary audit of the committed record. It characterises how much evidential weight the 2025 Pullback result should receive; it makes no accusation and changes nothing.

timeline.relevance: reference baseline; parameters are classic Turtle values fixed a priori

timeline.event: EXP-002 specification and configs frozen before implementation/runs.

timeline.relevance: costs shown not to be the primary cause of Turtle failure

timeline.event: EXP-003 specification frozen BEFORE implementation and before any run. It pre-registered long-only, short-only and combined as required variants with combined as the primary object.
timeline.relevance: the long/short/both variants were fixed before 2025 was observed; long-only itself was NOT selected after seeing 2025

timeline.event: EXP-003 strategy implemented; parameters (swing 2/2, ATR20, impulse>=3 ATR, depth 0.5-2.0 ATR, 10-bar recency, 3-bar confirmation, Donchian-10 exit, 2xATR stop, 1% risk) fixed a priori as round structural values, not fitted.
timeline.relevance: no hyperparameter search was performed for EXP-003

timeline.event: EXP-003 results recorded (DEC-004): combined FAIL, short FAIL, long-only 8/8 on the development sample with a 2025 OOS of +14.01% (PF 1.34).
timeline.relevance: the long-only emphasis emerged AFTER the combined variant failed; the long-only variant existed pre-registered, but its promotion to 'leading candidate' was a post-result narrative choice

timeline.event: EXP-004 pre-registered: fresh-OOS validation of the frozen long-only strategy on 2026-01-01..2026-09-16 (DEC-005 re-scope).
timeline.relevance: the holdout window and decision rule were fixed before the run

timeline.event: EXP-004 results recorded (DEC-006): FAILS FRESH OOS (PF 0.607, -12.75%, 64 trades).
timeline.relevance: the 2025 result did not replicate on unseen data

audit_answers.strategy_variants_compared_using_2025: Partially. EXP-003 reported long/short/combined, and the long-only 2025 OOS (+14.01%) was reported within EXP-003 itself; the 2025 window therefore informed the decision to prioritise the long-only variant even though the variant list was pre-registered.
audit_answers.long_only_selected_using_2025: No, strictly. Long-only was pre-registered in the EXP-003 specification before any run. However, its treatment as the leading candidate was reinforced by the 2025 result.
audit_answers.conclusion: The 2025 long-only result was produced by a pre-registered variant with a-priori parameters, and then used to justify a fresh holdout test. That is defensible, but the 2025 number carries the selection weight of one holdout on one variant chosen from a three-way split, and it was concentrated (see PHASE2_trade_diagnostics: removing the top 3 winners turns 2025 negative). Its evidential weight is therefore low-to-moderate, not confirmatory.
